items.title: The particle moves the location through time
items.caption: The place and the person stay fixed. Changing the tense particle moves the location from the past, through a change now, to the future.

states.label: Past
states.sm: Sā ʻi le fale le teine.
states.en: The girl was in the house.

states.label: Now there
states.sm: ʻUa ʻi le fale le teine.
states.en: The girl is now in the house.

states.label: Future
states.sm: ʻOleʻā ʻi le fale le teine.
states.en: The girl will be in the house.

items.title: Deny existence or deny a location
items.caption: The one-word there-is-none verb denies that a car exists there. The separate not-word before *ʻi ai* denies the girl's location.

states.label: Existence denied
states.sm: E leai se taʻavale ʻi le nuʻu.
states.en: There is no car in the village.

states.label: Location denied
states.sm: ʻO le nuʻu e lē ʻi ai le teine.
states.en: The girl is not in the village.
